inlines.v: BRITAN'NIC, adjective Pertaining to Britain; or in its present use, to Great Britain. It is applied almost exclusively to the title of the king; as his britannic Majesty. In the Encyclopedia, article Argo Navis, it is applied to catalogue, the britannic catalogue.
